title: cressa cretica var. indica
intro: Cressa cretica var. indica, commonly known as Indian snail kill, is a plant species in the family Convolvulaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, and research has shown that it possesses several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Cressa cretica var. indica include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and anti-cancer properties, attributed to its ability to inhibit the growth of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
